data: What is the approximate value of the orange line at the 1 Billion English word tokens seen?

The orange line represents the RSIM score for low-frequency (LFREQ) English words. To determine its approximate value at 1 billion English word tokens seen, we need to look at the graph corresponding to this point on the x-axis.

1. Locate the subfigure (a) Updates: EN, which shows the relationship between the number of updates and the RSIM score for different word frequencies.
2. Find the point where the x-axis reaches approximately 1 billion English word tokens seen.
3. Observe the position of the orange line (RSIM score for LFREQ) at this point.

From the graph, the orange line appears to be around 0.85 at the 1 billion English word tokens seen mark.
